subject: We have an MSA with [COMPANY] | AI annotation, curation & evaluation
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

We have an MSA in place with [COMPANY] as we work with some of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and automated visual inspection. Thought we could take advantage of the existing legal infrastructure to explore how we might collaborate with your specific team within BH as well.

For context, sophisticated AI/ML teams like [COMPANY], Fraunhofer or Philips usually come to us when they're at the point of scaling their model training & data pipelines. They mostly use Encord to improve their data curation / annotation and model evaluation processes to iterate on their AI models faster and/or reduce development costs. 

Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some of the other [COMPANY] teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's looking pretty open right now.

subject: Data annotation budgets [YEAR]
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Noticed that [COMPANY] recently released new Video AI analysis tools for Basketball & Volleyball, and was wondering if managing annotation budgets was top of mind as you continue to develop these products / expand into other sports?

Many CV leads of leading Sports Analytics AI teams we work with (inc. Hudl, Veo, and Spiideo) were struggling to balance customer demand for new products with the exploding data annotation costs required to train new models.

Using Encord, teams can annotate native video (vs. breaking videos down frame-by-frame) to accelerate annotation throughput - an approach which has helped Standard AI to save over $600k on annual annotation costs.

Open to learning more?

subject: Packing Punnets in [YEAR]
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Congratulations on your recent appointment as CTO - I've been following 4AG for some time & was very impressed to see the progress you made in [YEAR], including punnet packing & the expansion to Australia & Ireland.

Given the complexities of mushroom harvesting (e.g. dynamic trimming & requirements for a soft transfer), thought it could be relevant to introduce how Encord can help to support future model development (e.g. new product dev & re-training to support expansion to new geographies).

Many CTOs of the AgTech robotics teams we work with (e.g. Fox Robotics, Saga Robotics, Carbon Robotics) found curating training datasets from large volumes of customer data to be cumbersome, often relying on immature OS tools or one-off custom scripts as workarounds.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support the rapid curation of training datasets at scale, so ML teams can quickly mine edge cases for annotation & accelerate model development.

Open to learning more?
